Dashboard

University of Gondar Digital Platform — administration console.

Connected to the platform API. The sections below read and write through the Django API using your Keycloak session. The server decides every request: it enforces the platform-admin role, rejects stale writes, and applies the organization and site lifecycle rules — any refusal is shown on the screen that caused it.
